transport: identical
scanner: !add !note add
constructs: two revision constructs that closed their `(` and never opened a
  body, and one that did. The scanner reports the first two as malformed, and
  the check names them: `xtex build` already refused them from the CLI, so an
  author met a defect at build time that the editor never showed. The third is
  well formed and is the author's, wherever it is written.
